annotations.title: PDF to text, PDF text extraction: extract the text of a PDF document from a URL, page by page

description: Extract the text of a public PDF (up to 10 MB) from its URL, page by page, with title, author and page count. Choose the first page, how many pages (up to 200) and maxChars. arXiv abstract links work. If a site blocks our fetch, the Internet Archive's dated copy is read and the answer says so. Scanned, encrypted and non-PDF files fail uncharged. Use to read papers, invoices, reports and manuals into an agent. Example: url=https://bitcoin.org/bitcoin.pdf. Price $0.005/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

maxChars.description: Maximum characters of text returned across all pages (1000-200000, default 50000)

pages.description: How many pages to read (1-200, default 20)

url.description: Absolute public http(s) URL of the PDF
